entities.summary: Lake Niegocin is a lake in the Masurian Lake District of Poland's Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, until 1945 part of East Prussia in Germany. It is the seventh largest lake in Poland, with an area of 26.04 square kilometres (10.05 sq mi). Maximum depth is 39.7 metres (130 ft); average is 9.9 metres (32 ft).
